name: Captions AI
tagline: Captions is an AI-powered video creation app that automatically generates subtitles, removes filler words, and edits eye contact in real time. Content creators use it to produce polished talking-head videos for social media without manual editing. Its AI avatar feature also lets users create videos without appearing on camera.
